title: 6G Native AI and Channel Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.14591v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and wireless communications is widely regarded as a core objective of sixth-generation (6G) systems. However, both the meaning of native AI and the type of AI capability that should be embedded into future wireless systems remain open to interpretation. This paper discusses 6G native AI from a system-design perspective and argues that native AI should be co-designed, optimized, and deployed as an intrinsic component of the wireless system rather than as a removable post-deployment add-on. From this perspective, conventional task-specific supervised models are difficult to use as the main technical basis of native AI because they depend heavily on labeled data, generalize poorly across propagation conditions, and require fragmented designs for different channel-related tasks. Motivated by these limitations, we position channel foundation models (CFMs) as a channel-centric foundation-model

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14591v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人工智能（AI）与无线通信的融合被广泛视为第六代（6G）系统的核心目标。然而，原生AI的含义以及应嵌入未来无线系统的AI能力类型仍存在多种解读。本文从系统设计角度探讨6G原生AI，并主张原生AI应作为无线系统的固有组成部分进行协同设计、优化和部署，而非作为可移除的部署后附加组件。基于此视角，传统的任务特定监督模型难以作为原生AI的主要技术基础，因为它们高度依赖标注数据，在不同传播条件下的泛化能力较差，并且需要针对不同信道相关任务进行碎片化设计。鉴于这些局限性，我们将信道基础模型（CFMs）定位为以信道为中心的基础模型。
tldr: 本文提出6G原生AI应作为无线系统的内在组件进行协同设计，并引入信道基础模型（CFMs）作为核心技术支持，以克服传统任务特定模型的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that 6G native AI should be co-designed as an intrinsic wireless system component, proposing channel foundation models (CFMs) as the core technical basis to overcome limitations of conventional task-specific models.
